# Lexbor (sha256 pinned in cmake/Pins.cmake). Pure C HTML5/CSS/DOM/Selectors engine.
set(CCORD_LEXBOR_TARBALL "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lexbor-v${CCORD_PIN_LEXBOR_VERSION}.tar.gz")
if(NOT EXISTS "${CCORD_LEXBOR_TARBALL}")
  file(DOWNLOAD "${CCORD_PIN_LEXBOR_URL}" "${CCORD_LEXBOR_TARBALL}"
       EXPECTED_HASH SHA256=${CCORD_PIN_LEXBOR_SHA256} TLS_VERIFY ON STATUS ccord_dl_status)
endif()
file(SHA256 "${CCORD_LEXBOR_TARBALL}" ccord_lexbor_hash)
if(NOT ccord_lexbor_hash STREQUAL CCORD_PIN_LEXBOR_SHA256)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Lexbor tarball sha256 mismatch: got ${ccord_lexbor_hash}, pinned ${CCORD_PIN_LEXBOR_SHA256}")
endif()

set(CCORD_LEXBOR_EXTRACT "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/third_party/lexbor-src")
set(CCORD_LEXBOR_SRC "${CCORD_LEXBOR_EXTRACT}/lexbor-${CCORD_PIN_LEXBOR_VERSION}")
if(NOT EXISTS "${CCORD_LEXBOR_SRC}/CMakeLists.txt")
  file(ARCHIVE_EXTRACT INPUT "${CCORD_LEXBOR_TARBALL}" DESTINATION "${CCORD_LEXBOR_EXTRACT}")
endif()

set(LEXBOR_BUILD_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LEXBOR_BUILD_STATIC ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LEXBOR_BUILD_SEPARATELY OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LEXBOR_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LEXBOR_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LEXBOR_BUILD_TESTS_CPP OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LEXBOR_BUILD_UTILS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LEXBOR_INSTALL_HEADERS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LEXBOR_WITHOUT_THREADS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

# Temporarily relax C-Cord's global C23/-fno-extensions for upstream Lexbor sources.
set(_ccord_saved_c_std "${CMAKE_C_STANDARD}")
set(_ccord_saved_c_ext "${CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS}")
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS ON)
add_subdirectory("${CCORD_LEXBOR_SRC}" "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/third_party/lexbor-build" EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD "${_ccord_saved_c_std}")
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS "${_ccord_saved_c_ext}")

if(TARGET lexbor_static)
  set_target_properties(lexbor_static PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 11 C_EXTENSIONS ON)
  if(NOT MSVC)
    target_compile_options(lexbor_static PRIVATE -w)
  endif()
  add_library(ccord_lexbor INTERFACE)
  add_library(ccord::lexbor ALIAS ccord_lexbor)
  target_link_libraries(ccord_lexbor INTERFACE lexbor_static)
  target_include_directories(ccord_lexbor SYSTEM INTERFACE "${CCORD_LEXBOR_SRC}/source")
else()
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Lexbor did not produce lexbor_static target")
endif()
